Features
Mechanics
Modifiers
City is completed when its walls are fully closed.
City scores 2 points per tile and per coat of arms. An unfinished city scores only 1 point per tile and per coat of arms at the end of the game.
Tiles with this feature
Tiles in the game: {count} of {total}
Placing a tile with a crater causes a meteorite impact: a die roll decides how far the blast reaches, and every meeple and neutral figure standing on the hit tiles is knocked off the board.
Monastery is completed when it is surrounded by eight tiles.
Monastery scores 9 points. At the end of the game an unfinished monastery scores 1 point for itself and 1 for each neighbouring tile.
Road is completed when all of its ends are closed (by a crossing, a city, a monastery or a loop).
Road scores 1 point per tile. An unfinished road still scores 1 point per tile at the end of the game.
A shrine is scored like a monastery.
